audience: creators who sell digital products and memberships on Gumroad

useCases.title: Look up sales by date, product or buyer email
useCases.text: The AI lists your successful sales with date, email and product or order filters, newest first. It can total them by product so you see what sold.

useCases.title: Check a license key or record a use
useCases.text: The AI checks that a license key is valid for a product and shows the purchase details. By default it does not count a use; it can also record one use.

useCases.title: Create or change an offer code
useCases.text: The AI lists a product's offer codes, creates a new discount code, or changes the code text or the max purchase count of an existing one.

useCases.title: Review the subscribers of a membership product
useCases.text: The AI lists the subscribers of a membership product, or finds one by buyer email, and reads one subscriber in detail.

useCases.title: Publish or unpublish products; enable or disable licenses
useCases.text: The AI enables a product so it can be sold, or disables it so it can no longer be sold. You can also have it turn a product's license key on or off.
